verdict.rationale: Motion's own AI meeting assistant offers booking pages that surface your 'ideal time slots' based on preferred meeting windows and daily limits, and its AI calendar reshuffles your day when meetings run long. That partly covers choosing a better time than the first open slot. The evidence only covers the host's own merged calendars, not analysis across all attendees' calendars, and the reshuffling appears aimed at the user's day rather than at re-optimizing meeting times. missing for 10: cross-attendee calendar analysis for picking meeting times, continuous re-optimization of already-scheduled meetings, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, AI finds and continuously optimizes the best meeting time across all attendees' calendars, not just the first open slot

citations.quote: embed Motion's AI Calendar on your website so prospects can book your ideal time slots instantly.
